title: Death Coordinates Notification
description: Displays where you died in the Overworld, Nether or End, directly in chat.
body:
## Description This simple datapack displays a player's death coordinates in the chat. The message also includes the dimension the player died in.

**Example:** ![Example Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/add527bf14c5793d6b614bff36c44962fbfde29f.png)

### How to uninstall the datapack /function death_coordinates:uninstall Run this function to fully remove the datapack.
